verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI has no shared team workspace. The closest it offers is project context files (GEMINI.md) and `--include-directories` to pull multiple local repo and docs folders into one session, which a team could approximate by committing context files to a repo. One hands-on user report says GEMINI.md is sometimes ignored, which weakens even this workaround. Missing for 10: a first-class shared or team workspace, ingestion of docs and repos into a persistent common knowledge base, team access and sharing controls, and independent evidence of team use.
